title: Template-Driven Machine Learning Standardization for Large Model Fleets
abstract: arXiv:2603.24963v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern computational advertising platforms typically rely on recommendation systems to predict user responses, such as click-through rates, conversion rates, and other optimization events. To support a wide variety of product surfaces and advertiser goals, these platforms maintain an extensive ecosystem of machine learning (ML) models. Operating at this scale, however, creates significant development and efficiency challenges: substantial engineering effort is required to regularly refresh these models and propagate new techniques, resulting in long latencies when deploying innovations across the ecosystem. translated_title: 面向大规模模型集群的模板驱动机器学习标准化
translated_abstract: 现代计算广告平台通常依赖推荐系统来预测用户响应，例如点击率、转化率以及其他优化事件。为了支持各种各样的产品界面和广告主目标，这些平台维护着一个庞大的机器学习（ML）模型生态系统。然而，在这种规模下运营会带来显著的开发和效率挑战：需要大量的工程工作来定期更新这些模型并推广新技术，导致在整个生态系统中部署创新时出现较长的延迟。我们提出了一项大规模实证研究，比较了推荐系统中标准化模型构建方法与独立的单模型优化之间在模型性能、效率和技术传播方面的差异。为了促进标准化，我们提出了标准模型模板（SMT）——一个能够生成高（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了标准模型模板（SMT）框架，通过标准化机器学习模型构建方式来替代独立的单模型优化，在大规模推荐系统模型生态中显著提升了开发效率、模型性能与新技术推广速度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Standard Model Template (SMT), a framework that standardizes machine learning model building across large model fleets, achieving better performance, efficiency, and faster technique propagation than independent per-model optimization in recommendation systems.
